intent: A dark-first, monochrome Apple-grade settings screen for a journaling app: a large title that folds into a glass nav bar, graphite inset groups with monochrome tiles, physical switches, a gliding segmented control, a snapping slider, a row that expands in place and a glass confirm sheet, all choreographed in on first view with one accent.

stack.web: react-native-web compatible; animate opacity on the BlurView itself, not a parent

layout.nav: absolute, 54pt status + 44pt bar, solid accent Done pill on the right
layout.profile: 68pt avatar: 2pt halo ring around a 56pt light disc with initials; name, email, neutral plan pill, three-up stats strip
layout.groups: 26pt apart; 13pt uppercase header; radius-20 card; 52pt rows with 30pt monochrome tiles and inset hairline separators
sections: Reading: segmented paper, text size slider, live preview
Writing: reminder switch, expandable time row, prompts
Privacy & sync: Face ID, iCloud sync, Export
layout.sheet: inset 10pt, radius 34, icon disc, title, body, destructive and cancel buttons

color.approach: monochrome first, dark by default; one neutral family per theme, one accent prop, semantic red, real paper colours
color.theme: prop `theme`: "dark" (default) | "light"; one token object and one StyleSheet per theme

dark.stageGlow: white radial at 7% from the top left + 4pt dither

color.accent: #34C77B (prop `accent`): switch fills, slider fill, selected chip, Done, sync light, restore glyph; text on it is black or white by WCAG luminance
color.destructive: #E5484D for the delete row and button only
color.navGlass: BlurView 100 (theme tint) + 82%→66% background wash + hairline, faded in by scroll

motion.navGlass: blur, wash and hairline fade in over the first 36pt of scroll; small title fades and rises 6pt between 30 and 48pt
motion.largeTitle: pull-down scales it to 1.12 from its left edge
motion.rowPress: 5–6% highlight in 90ms, out 320ms; tile springs to 0.9
motion.switch: knob spring 520/26 with one small landing; stretches 6pt toward the centre while held; accent fill fades in
motion.segmented: thumb spring 500/40, squeezes to 0.95 while held; preview papers crossfade 340ms
motion.slider: 1:1 drag, rubber-band past the ends, velocity-aware snap (420/30), 1.16 tick pulse, value bubble
motion.expand: measured height 380ms ease-out open / 260ms close, content fades and drops 8pt, chevron rotates 90°
motion.sheet: springs up 340/34, drag to dismiss, spinner then accent check button with a 1.04 overshoot while the trash disc crossfades to a check; counts tween to 0
motion.reducedMotion: entrances become 150ms fades, numbers set instantly; no springs or scale; instant height; 120ms fades
motion.entrance: title 0ms, Done and profile 55ms, Reading 110ms, Writing 165ms; lower sections wait until 48pt in view then arrive at once; each fades in, rises 12pt and clears an 8px blur over 520ms ease-out (iOS: scale 0.98 instead of blur)
motion.profileEntrance: 150ms after the card: stats count up from 0 over 680ms with a 5px blur settling; avatar halo draws clockwise over 720ms via strokeDashoffset; plan pill pops last (spring 400/28)
motion.sliderEntrance: fill and thumb run from the left end to the value over 480ms, 260ms after the Reading section lands; grabbing takes over
motion.swap: values and footers crossfade with a 4pt rise when they change

responsive.width: 360–430pt; time chips align to the text column from 380pt and take the full row below that

accessibility: Switches use role switch with checked state; the whole row also toggles
Segmented control is a tablist with selected tabs
Slider is adjustable with min, max, now, a spoken value and increment/decrement actions
Time chips are radios in a radiogroup
The expanding row reports expanded; the confirm button reports busy
The large title is a header; SVG icons are hidden

content.profile: Inês Marlowe, ines@marlowe.studio, Folio Plus renews 2 Mar, 412 entries, 38-day streak, 96.2k words
content.sample: Thursday, 9 October: Rain on the tram windows all the way to Graça…

avoid: Rainbow icon tiles or a different hue per row
Tinted washes or coloured plan pills and avatar rings
A light-only design; dark is the default
A flat translucent grey nav bar
Rows that cut open instead of animating height
Opacity animated on a BlurView's parent
